detail: Decisions: Auto-archive trigger counts only archivable entries (excludes decision cross-posts and archive-tagged summaries) and the archiver's summary post carries _skipAutoArchive — the 7.6M-finding loop came from counting permanently-unarchivable decisions and the archiver re-arming itself.; twining_record truncates over-length summaries/findings (full text preserved in detail) instead of rejecting — the gate tool failed 38% of calls in the field on a cap the schema never disclosed; direct twining_post keeps strict validation.; Subagent-stop hook posts nothing when agent identity is unknown — field data shows 100% of its output was content-free 'unknown-subagent' noise; silence beats noise.; migrateForward enumerates decisions by directory scan unioned with the index — the field analysis found 109 index-orphaned decisions that index-driven migration would silently exclude while verify passed.
summary: 1.24.0 field-findings release planned: archive loop, record truncation, finding surfacing, pending drain, hook silence, depends_on validation, orphan salvage. Shipping unattended; v2 gated on it.
